Your plan is changing on 1 March

From the start of your next billing period, the plan you are on will include twice the storage and an extra seat, at the price you pay today. There is nothing you need to do: the change is made for you, and your invoices will show it from the first period it applies to. If you would rather stay on the plan as it is, reply to this message before the end of the month and we will keep it for you for another year. You can read the details of what is changing, and why, on the plan changes page, and you can compare every plan side by side before you decide. Seats you add later are billed from the day you add them, and storage you no longer use is never charged for.
